unit: H257 - Test exchange and background sender

This is the test exchange: no money is t.en: This is the test exchange: no money is taken and the bill is not marked paid.

Test payment recorded — nothing was char.en: Test payment recorded — nothing was charged. The cashier posts real payments from the provider's statement.
